crossRefs.note: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have…
“ ‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would…
and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them…

translations.web: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’ ”
translations.bsb: Let us buy the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the chaff with the wheat!”
translations.kjv: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
translations.asv: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
